# 🌍 Inbound Attack Origins — Cyber Range

Geolocates every external source that attempted **failed remote logons** against the cyber-range environment (public RDP / network brute force). Bubble **size & color** = failed-logon volume from that source. This is the internet-wide background of credential-attack traffic the range absorbs — the same class of activity that, against host **corp-gng-940**, produced incident **IR-2026-0728-GNG940**.

> Enriched with the native `geo_info_from_ip_address()` function. Geo data (MaxMind GeoLite2) is approximate — read as regions, not pinpoints.

content.query:
// Inbound attack origins — all external failed remote logons across the range.
DeviceLogonEvents
| where Timestamp {TimeRange}
| where ActionType == "LogonFailed"
| where RemoteIPType == "Public" and isnotempty(RemoteIP)
| extend geo = geo_info_from_ip_address(RemoteIP)
| extend Latitude  = toreal(geo.latitude),
         Longitude = toreal(geo.longitude),
         Country   = tostring(geo.country),
         City      = tostring(geo.city)
| where isnotempty(Latitude) and isnotempty(Longitude)
| summarize Events = count() by RemoteIP, Country, City, Latitude, Longitude
| extend MapLabel = strcat(RemoteIP, " (", Country, ") — ", Events, " failed logons")
| project Latitude, Longitude, MapLabel, Events, RemoteIP, Country, City
| order by Events desc
content.title: Inbound attack origins — bubble size = failed-logon volume

content.query:
// Companion grid: all external failed remote logons across the range, ranked.
DeviceLogonEvents
| where Timestamp {TimeRange}
| where ActionType == "LogonFailed"
| where RemoteIPType == "Public" and isnotempty(RemoteIP)
| extend geo = geo_info_from_ip_address(RemoteIP)
| summarize Events = count(),
            TargetedDevices = dcount(DeviceName),
            Accounts = make_set(AccountName, 25)
         by RemoteIP,
            Country = tostring(geo.country),
            City    = tostring(geo.city)
| order by Events desc
content.title: Attack origins — detail table
